category_edits.rationale: Reduce observed-history length from 128 to 32 across all four categories to test whether excluding older interactions reduces stale-interest interference. Existing checkpoint metadata saves MAXLEN and drives inference truncation. Preserve final-real-position readout, embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer.

change_summary: Use a 32-item observed-history window for training and inference, with matching predictor fallback and existing checkpoint metadata.
